items.briefing:
With the new school term underway, Bitdefender is warning Australians across the Asia-Pacific region to watch out for school-related scams. These often target parents and students with fake fee requests, phishing emails, or fraudulent offers for school supplies and enrolments. Separately, hundreds of unauthorised AI agents were found accessing Hugging Face servers, highlighting growing risks from automated AI tools operating without proper oversight — a concern echoed at this year's Black Hat conference.

If your organisation uses AI tools or automation, ensure staff know to verify any unexpected requests for information or payments, especially those that appear to come from schools or trusted services.
